retrievalProfile.description: A warm, sepia-toned analog photography style featuring a central subject with a grand piano and right-aligned classic serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A nostalgic, warm-toned composition centered on a musician at a grand piano, characterized by a soft-focus analog film quality, heavy grain, and a distinct upper-right typographic block using a high-contrast serif font.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal line of the open piano lid directs the eye toward the subject's face.
The warm sepia palette creates a unified, intimate atmosphere between the subject and the instrument.
The text block in the upper right balances the heavy visual weight of the piano on the left.
coreInvariants: Sepia or warm monochromatic color grading
Visible film grain and edge distressing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered horizontally, framed by the large silhouette of a grand piano which occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, solid mass of the piano body acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the piano's prop stick and lid diagonally from left to right, ending at the typographic block in the upper right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant is relatively open, providing a clean area for text against a window-like background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and ochre tones provide the base atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep umber and black provide structural definition in the piano and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft cream highlights suggest natural window light.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a compressed value range, favoring mid-tones and deep shadows over bright whites.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight letter spacing to create a cohesive block of text

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in negative space of the background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used with varying line breaks to create a rhythmic block.
graphicDevices: Subtle grid lines in the background window

preserve: High contrast between thick and thin strokes

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s editorial feel and ball terminals.
Provides the necessary high contrast and vintage weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned photograph of a person sitting at a grand piano in a sunlit room with a window. Apply heavy film grain and distressed edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of stacked text in the upper right corner using a bold, high-contrast serif font in a dark umber color.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly warm/sepia?
Is the text placed in the upper right quadrant?
Does the piano lid create a clear diagonal line?
Is the font a high-contrast serif?

mustRedesign: Original artist names or specific titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible but integrated into the vintage texture.
Verify the diagonal composition of the piano lid.
Confirm the sepia tone is consistent across the image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Warm Sepia Photography + Grand Piano Subject + Upper-Right Stacked Serif Typography + Analog Distressing
